name: Analytical and Computational Methods in Civil Engineering
description: Introduction: vector spaces, function spaces, norms in discrete and continuous systems, tensors, linear transformations, tensor calculus; linear ordinary differential equation (ODEs); linear partial differential equation (PDEs); Fourier and Laplace transforms; analytical solutions for ODEs and PDEs; nonlinear differential equations; Lagrangian and Hamiltonian, variational calculus, Euler-Lagrange equation, Noether’s theorem, mesh-based and mesh-free numerical methods for solving PDEs; linearization and iterative solvers; eigenvalue problems; Lagrange multiplier and penalty approaches; stability and convergence analysis; LBB condition; large matrices; sparse matrices. Applications to various civil engineering problems.
